snippet.title: Mancalero (Demo) Trailer
snippet.description:
The *Mancalero Playtest* launches on Steam on August 7th.

Mancalero is a roguelike marble deck-builder strategy game inspired by the classic board game Mancala. Collect special marbles, build powerful synergies, face unique bosses, and push your run as far as possible.

This trailer gives a first look at the official demo coming to Steam, featuring the core gameplay loop, marble effects, boss encounters, and the paper-pixel style of Mancalero.

*Wishlist Mancalero on Steam:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/4811700/Mancalero/

*Playtest available August 7th. Demo available later in September*

Developed by ArchiusDev.

Music: "Solecism", "Skyscraper Samba", "Simulacra" by Scott Buckley — CC-BY 4.0.
